title: Genesis scATAC sample sheet from raw 10x reads
description: One row per 10x scATAC library, read from NCBI SRA with its barcode read. workflows/scatac-reads.nf also checks the exact header, reference files, that the whitelist exists or can be downloaded, reference IDs and per-reference consistency.

sample_id.errorMessage: sample_id must start with a letter, digit or underscore and contain only letters, digits, underscores, periods and hyphens

species.errorMessage: species must start with a letter, digit or underscore and contain only letters, digits, underscores, periods and hyphens

sra_runs.errorMessage: sra_runs must be one or more SRA run accessions of one library (its lanes), comma-separated, such as SRR12340627,SRR12340628

cells_url.errorMessage: cells_url must be an HTTP or HTTPS URL of a barcode<TAB>group cell list, or - to call cells

reference_fasta.errorMessage: reference_fasta must be a gzipped FASTA basename ending in .fa.gz, .fasta.gz or .fna.gz

reference_genes.errorMessage: reference_genes must be a BED6 basename ending in .bed in the references folder, or - to skip TSS enrichment

organelle_contigs.errorMessage: organelle_contigs must be comma-separated contig names, or - for none

barcode_whitelist.errorMessage: barcode_whitelist must be a 10x barcode list basename (.txt or .txt.gz) in the references folder or 737K-cratac-v1.txt (downloaded when missing), or - for no barcode correction
